description: This file defines a PHP class 'ViewVcard' that extends 'SugarView' and handles the display action for a vCard view within the SuiteCRM application. It loads contact data into a vCard object and saves it.

classes.name: ViewVcard
classes.description: A PHP class that manages the display of a vCard in SuiteCRM, loading contact info and saving the vCard.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Loads contact data based on the current bean and module, then saves the vCard.
